name: @cei/sdk
description: Official JavaScript SDK for the CEI (Constitutional Education Intelligence) Public API

scripts.test: node -e "const CEI = require('./index'); const c = new CEI.Client({ baseUrl: 'http://localhost:5000' }); c.scoring.activeVersion().then(v => console.log('SDK Test PASS:', v?.data?.versionId || 'no active version')).catch(e => console.log('SDK Test (network expected):', e.message))"
